How to choose

Choose Aero 14 for the best-rated balance of OLED picture quality, battery life and portability.

Choose Forge 16 when processor power, upgradeability and a broad port selection matter more than weight or battery life.

Choose Nimbus 13 to spend the least, carry the lightest laptop and get the longest battery life.

One trade-off to consider: Nimbus 13’s 256 GB SSD is the smallest. Forge 16 offers the most storage at 1,024 GB, while Aero 14 sits between them at 512 GB.
